text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Trainer! Ya got the magic
touch!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y'know, I think I picked up a thing or
two watchin'
from the sidelines. I dunno
if I can get that claw
lined up as good as
you though!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey. Ya gotta do that in front of my
siblin's
some time. They won't believe
what they're seein'!
